item.title: Inference with vLLM
item.description:
• generative models: llm = LLM(model=..., task="generate") (task=generate) only
  • pooling models: llm = LLM(model=..., task="embed") (task={embed,classify,reward}) only
  • upon success, generative models returns text, pooling models return hidden states.

Custom model integration #

  1. git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/
  2. Add a file in Transformers repository and put it into the vllm/model_executor/models directory

Existing Model Executors #

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/tree/main/vllm/model_executor/models

hugging face transformer repo #

  • .gitattributes

    Configures Git behavior, usually Git LFS tracking for large weight files. Not used during inference.

item.title: Torch and PyTorch
item.description:
Torch was an early machine-learning framework with a Lua interface and a C/CUDA core. PyTorch is its successor ecosystem: it retains the name and some implementation heritage, but it is an actively developed framework centered on Python and C++ APIs. LibTorch is PyTorch’s C++ distribution.

Install PyTorch #

For most Python projects, install the published package using the command generated by the PyTorch installation selector. The appropriate package depends on the operating system, Python version, and whether the application uses CPU, CUDA, or another accelerator backend.
